headlines.title: Viola Davis Reveals She Was Diagnosed With Shingles
headlines.description: Viola Davis is opening up about the time she had shingles, and a blistering rash spread accross her body. Now, the actor is spreading awareness about prevention.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: 6 High-Fiber Fall Foods for Better Gut Health, Recommended by a GI Doctor
headlines.description: In TODAY.com’s Expert Tip of the Day, a gastroenterologist reveals her top high-fiber fall fruits and vegetables to support gut health.

headlines.title: How to Set Boundaries at Home and at Work Without the Guilt
headlines.description: Setting boundaries can be difficult and guilt-inducing, but it doesn't have to be. Psychotherapist and author Niro Feliciano joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share helpful tips on how to set boundaries in your personal, romantic and work life. She explains how creating limits for yourself can foster healthier relationships and better mental health. "Anyone who has issues with your boundaries," Feliciano says, "they're the people who benefited from you not having them."

headlines.title: Foods to Add to Your Diet for a Healthy and Happy Gut
headlines.description: Maintaining a healthy gut is a vital way to lower risks of illnesses like heart disease and dementia. Gastrointestinal health expert Dr. Trisha Pasricha joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share tips to improve gut health, including eating more fiber, diversifying fruits and vegetables in meals, and introducing fermented foods into your diet.

headlines.title: WHO seeks answers and clarity over plague lab death in Russia
headlines.description: The World Health Organization is pushing for more answers and clarity in the plague death that happened in a lab in Russia. NBC News' Dr. Akshay Syal has more on what we know about the illness and what WHO is seeking from Russia.

headlines.title: Report finds discounts on Trump's drug website are hit or miss
headlines.description: As President Trump increasingly touts his "TrumpRx" drug website, a recent analysis shows the savings offered through the program are hit or miss. NBC News' Berkeley Lovelace has details on the potential savings offered through the website amid a slight dip in overall prices.

headlines.description: October Prime Day is over, but some deals are still live. Discover discounts on tech, home, beauty and more that are still worth shopping.

headlines.description: October Prime Day is over, but some tech deals are still live. Shop editor-picked discounts on headphones, TVs, smart home devices and more.

headlines.description: NBC Selected editors found the best Amazon deals under $50 across home, beauty, tech, travel and more.

headlines.title: FDA says it will complete safety review of abortion pill in March
headlines.description: A federal judge in Louisiana ordered the agency to provide an update on its safety study as part of a lawsuit seeking to overturn a provision allowing mifepristone to be delivered by mail.
